ev.q: This report describes the first known case of LACV infection in a pregnant woman
LACV-specific IgM antibodies were detected in umbilical cord serum
This report summarizes the first case of symptomatic LACV infection identified during pregnancy
This report describes the first known case of LACV infection in a pregnant woman

methods_quotes.q: Umbilical cord serum and maternal serum were tested for LACV-specific antibodies by ELISA and serum-dilution plaque-reduction neutralization test (PRNT)
Sera also were tested for neutralizing antibodies to the closely related Jamestown Canyon virus by PRNT to rule out potential cross-reactivity
